title: Consciousness may be bound to the organization of living systems

statements.text: Living systems maintain themselves across many interacting levels, from processes inside neurons up to the organism, and present software captures none of that. Consciousness may be linked to this organization so that it cannot be abstracted away from its machinery, though the authors do not claim it can only arise in living systems.

sources.quote: we have to at least entertain the possibility that consciousness is linked to the complex biological organization underlying life
here we are not arguing that consciousness can only arise in living systems
